title: Israeli holidays 2025–2030 (Hebrew + English)
description: Jewish and Israeli national holidays, fasts and memorial days as observed in Israel (one-day Yom Tov, 7-day Pesach, Israeli postponement rules), computed with the arithmetic Hebrew calendar and cross-checked against two independent libraries (hdate, pyluach). start = first daytime date; holidays with begins=sunset_previous_day start the evening before (eve). rest_day = statutory day of rest in Israel.
method: data-il/tools/hebrew_calendar.py (Dershowitz & Reingold arithmetic calendar); verified by data-il/tools/verify_holidays.py

sources.title: Dershowitz & Reingold, Calendrical Calculations (arithmetic Hebrew calendar)
hdate (py-libhdate), used to cross-check every date
pyluach, used to cross-check religious holidays and fasts
